column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key uniquely identifying each physical durability record.
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing RGB(RgbRegistry), linking durability data to RGB hardware (often in keyboards or mice).
A VARCHAR(20) foreign key referencing Performance(PerfRegistry), associating physical durability with overall performance metrics.
A SMALLINT specifying the device’s weight in grams.
A VARCHAR(30) describing weight distribution (e.g., 'Front Heavy', 'Back Heavy', 'Balanced').
A SMALLINT measuring the cable’s weight in grams (if relevant).
A VARCHAR(25) characterizing the cable’s drag or friction level (e.g., 'Moderate', 'Minimal', 'Significant').
A VARCHAR(25) naming the material of the device’s feet/skates (e.g., Glass, Virgin PTFE, PTFE, Ceramic).
A NUMERIC(3,1) indicating thickness (in mm) of the device’s feet/skates.
A NUMERIC(4,1) measuring gliding consistency or friction uniformity (relative scale).
A NUMERIC(3,2) specifying static friction coefficient or rating.
A NUMERIC(3,2) specifying kinetic friction coefficient or rating.
A VARCHAR(25) indicating the recommended or tested surface compatibility (e.g., Cloth Preferred, Hard Pad Preferred, Universal).
A VARCHAR(30) describing the handle/grip style (e.g., Palm, Hybrid, Fingertip, Claw).
A VARCHAR(30) naming the grip coating type (must match GripCoat_enum if relevant).
A SMALLINT specifying approximate grip durability or rating (e.g., hours or a scale).
A VARCHAR(30) detailing sweat resistance or finish claim (e.g., Low, Medium, High).
An enum (TempRes_enum) describing the temperature resistance level (Standard, Premium, Enhanced).
An enum (HumidRes_enum) indicating humidity resistance level (Standard, Premium, Enhanced).
A VARCHAR(30) referencing dust ingress rating or claim (e.g., IPX1, IPX2, IPX3, IPX0).
A VARCHAR(35) referencing water ingress protection (e.g., IPX1, IPX3, IPX0, IPX2).
A VARCHAR(30) describing impact resistance (e.g., Standard, Military Grade, Enhanced).
A NUMERIC(3,1) measuring the tested or guaranteed drop height in meters.
A SMALLINT indicating how much force (in N or a relative scale) is needed for noticeable bending.
A SMALLINT specifying the angle (in degrees) at which twisting becomes significant or detrimental.
An INTEGER showing the tested cable bend cycles or durability count.
An INTEGER representing how many connect-disconnect cycles the USB port can handle before failure.
